content_sections.text: RITES, a Government of India Enterprise and Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Railways, has officially released VC No. CL/08/26 dated 21 August 2026 for the recruitment of 8 Engineer posts on a contract lump-sum basis. content_sections.heading: RITES Engineer Vacancy 2026 Details
content_sections.text: RITES is recruiting for one post under VC No. CL/08/26, with a total of 8 vacancies as per the category-wise break-up below. No vacancies have been notified under the EWS and ST categories for this post as per the official notification.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for the post of Engineer (VC No. CL/08/26) must possess any one of the following: Full-time Diploma in Mechanical/Metallurgical branch of Engineering with UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT), or Full-time Degree in Mechanical/Metallurgical branch of Engineering with UT Level-2 Certificate (ASNT/ISNT) The Diploma/Degree must be from an institution recognised by BTE/AICTE, or from a university incorporated by an Act of Central or State legislature in India, or from an institution established/deemed under the University Grants Commission Act, 1956. Sections A & B examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India), treated as equivalent to a Degree and recognised by AICTE, are also accepted. Candidates from UR/EWS category (and SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates applying against unreserved posts) must have a first-class degree or a minimum of 60% marks. Reserved category candidates applying against reserved posts must have at least 50% marks. Where the certificate or marksheet does not show a class/division or percentage, candidates must submit the CGPA/DGPA conversion formula issued by their university; where no such formula exists, an authorised undertaking is required, with a minimum of 6 on a 10-point scale considered equivalent to 60%. For Diploma holders: Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience For Degree holders: Minimum 2 years of post-qualification experience Preference will be given to candidates possessing NDT experience. The period of training (except on-the-job training), internship, teaching, academic work, fellowship, or PhD research experience will not be counted towards the required experience. Age Relaxation: SC/ST category: 5 years OBC-NCL category: 3 years Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD): 10 years, in addition to any age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC-NCL candidates, subject to the post being identified as suitable for PWD PwBD candidates with not less than 40% of the relevant disability are eligible for the 10-year age relaxation, subject to meeting the identified physical requirements and functional classifications for the post (locomotor disability category, as specified in the official notification).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Before applying, ensure you satisfy the eligibility conditions and requirements for the post. Visit the Career Section of the RITES website, www.rites.com , and apply online in the prescribed registration format. Note down the Registration Number generated on the online form after submission, and quote it in all further communication with RITES Ltd. Carefully fill in the Identity Proof details and ensure the same document will be available for verification later, if called. Upload all required documents under the "Upload Document" section of the application form. Make the online payment under the "Make Payment" section and download the final application form after successful payment. Applications without successful fee payment will be treated as incomplete and summarily rejected. Hard copies of documents should not be sent to RITES by post or courier.

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Documents Required
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload the following documents during the online application: High School certificate as proof of Date of Birth Certificates and mark sheets of all semesters/years for all claimed qualifications (Xth, XIIth, Diploma/Graduation/Post-Graduation) Percentage Conversion Document issued by the University/Institute (wherever applicable) EWS/SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD Certificate in the prescribed Government of India format (wherever applicable) Proof of Identity and Address (Passport, Voter ID, Driving Licence, Aadhaar Card, etc.) PAN Card Proof of each period of claimed experience (offer letter, joining order, relieving letter, service certificate, relevant pay slips) submitted as a single PDF in chronological order Any other document required in support of candidature and claims made in the application form Candidates must ensure scanned copies are clear and visible; failure to upload the necessary documents can lead to cancellation of candidature. At the time of document verification/interview, self-attested photocopies of these documents (in a specified order, along with a recent passport-size colour photograph) must be produced, along with two duly filled copies of Annexure-A (Documents Submission Checklist).

content_sections.heading: RITES Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process consists of the following stages: Document Scrutiny/Verification: All candidates who successfully submit the online application are provisionally allowed to appear for document scrutiny to verify their eligibility for the applied post. Interview: Shortlisted/eligible candidates are called for an interview, which carries a weightage of 100% - split as Technical & Professional proficiency (65%) and Personality, Communication & Competency (35%). A minimum of 60% marks in the interview is required for UR/EWS candidates (50% for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PWD candidates against reserved posts) to be considered for placement on the panel; there is no separate minimum qualifying mark in the aggregate. RITES Ltd. reserves the right to shortlist the number of candidates for interview out of the eligible pool, and may conduct the written test, document verification, or interview from its Regional Offices as per requirement. Candidates may opt to appear for the interview in Hindi or English. Selected candidates must also be found medically fit as per RITES' Standards of Medical Fitness before final appointment.

content_sections.heading: Interview Venue
content_sections.text: Candidates must indicate their preferred interview location at the time of application; the exact date and location will be communicated at the time of admit card issuance.
